memory_repairs.name: restart_unit
memory_repairs.description: Restart a unit the registry names for this host when that unit has no live process, which is the state a process that could not allocate leaves behind.

memory_repairs.name: reap_recovery
memory_repairs.description: Run a host-recovery program this release already ships, by name, and record what that program decided; recover-skarbiec-crypto reaps stale GnuPG daemons.

memory_repairs.name: graphical_session
memory_repairs.description: End a named process of the logged-in graphical session, and only when the declaration also carries allow_graphical_session.
